question.en: Given that 106 0.02 = x, 106 0.59 = y and x z = y 9 , then the value of z is:

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **265.5** ($z = 265.5 \approx 265.5$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 106! Directly equate exponents: $0.02z = 0.59 \times 9 = 5.31 \Rightarrow z = 5.31 / 0.02 \approx 265.5$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 106 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.02z = 0.59 \times 9 \Rightarrow z \approx 265.5$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 106^{0.02}$ and $y = 106^{0.59}$ into $x^z = y^{9}$:
$106^{0.02z} = 106^{0.59 \times 9} = 106^{5.31}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.02z = 5.31 \Rightarrow z = \frac{5.31}{0.02} = 265.5000 \approx \mathbf{265.5}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.59 : 0.02 = 59 : 2$ ⇒ $z = \frac{59 \times 9}{2} = 531/2 \approx \mathbf{265.5}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 106^{0.02}$ व $y = 106^{0.59}$ को $x^z = y^{9}$ में रखें:
$106^{0.02z} = 106^{5.31} \Rightarrow 0.02z = 5.31 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{265.5}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.59 \times 9}{0.02} \approx \mathbf{265.5}$।
